title: Navigator One competitive intelligence and clean-room reverse-engineering design tribunal
owner_authorization_scope: Explicit 2026-11-18 user request for a distinct Sol 6.2 MAX learning run. Storage consent is not the paid release; require native exact packet hash trigger after reviewed merge and budget checks. Current shared policy prefers 6.2 after project GET, records actual model and retains 6.1 fallback; no Astra.
question: Conduct a source-bounded competitive architecture tribunal using the two Navigator One evidence/mission files and the earlier AUTO_TRADING audits. Extract and challenge real code primitives for deterministic paper fills, quote evidence, risk/refusal, wallet privacy, event replay, UX and research. Go function by function only where source observation is supplied; otherwise classify evidence as documentation/tree/metadata or WAIT_SOURCE. Create clean-room specifications, alternatives, falsifiers, implementation acceptance and review handoff that exceed reference systems on explicit measurable design criteria, not imagined economic performance. Prioritize 10 best primitives, 5 anti-patterns, 3 follow-up source probes; no duplicate scanner, millisecond execution assumption, full bot adoption, or unsupported chain coverage. Compare overlap with earlier #885 #937 #1512 #1557 #1133 and Alpha #228. No network/tool access inferred; external links are citations, not evidence you fetched. Source-available BUSL and unknown license are no-copy; respect copyleft and permissive obligations. No private data, source changes or model authority.
hypothesis: A small composable read-only, evidence-first product layer plus deterministic paper adapters can outperform reference architectures on provable data honesty, refusal accountability, restart safety and UX while preserving existing scientific and producer owners. More features or AI agents do not establish incremental merit.
baseline: Existing Navigator One design seed plus September AUTO_TRADING second-pass audit, existing science and paper owners; the exact source observations in the new manifest and explicitly weaker documentation-only candidates. Compare no-build, adapters, and external component reuse after licensing.
falsifier: Reject any transferable idea whose claimed behavior lacks source evidence, is already implemented by an existing owner, has incompatible/unknown reuse terms, expands privilege, creates a duplicate producer or cannot beat a specified acceptance baseline. Reject any claim of incremental economic edge lacking frozen prospective after-cost outcomes. If source-level evidence missing, WAIT_SOURCE and propose bounded source probes.
kill_condition: No runtime code, deployment, paid retries, real orders, signer, wallet connection, private inputs, Round 3 scoring, automatic merge, new queue, scheduler, API scope change, state/forecast/threshold change or Astra. No copying source-available or proprietary code. Do not override earlier rejection of TradingView data MCP, Condor runtime, or deferment of matching engines.
required_outputs: SOURCE_BOUND_COMPONENT_MATRIX: actual evidence class, repo/commit/path/blob, observed invariant, candidate transfer, license, owner and gap
TOP_10_CLEAN_ROOM_PRIMITIVES with acceptance tests, failure modes, negative controls, dependencies and measurable baseline
THREE_SOURCE_PROBES with precise requested evidence and no invented paths
A_B_C_ARCHITECTURE_TRADEOFF including no-build and minimal adapter path
TYPED_HANDOFF_AND_PAPER_RECEIPT_DESIGN: deterministic fail closed, concurrency/idempotency, quote TTL, actual-vs-mark, privacy
SCIENTIFIC_ABLATION_AND_COST_TESTS: no false edge, trial accounting, refusal and opportunity cost
PRIORITIZED_INCREMENTAL_ROADMAP and Astra/Claude/Fable independent review handoff; no implementation
ADVERSARIAL_VERDICT with limitations and no authority
forbidden: Private data or repository contents, user video/holdings, full third-party source copying, code write or merge, paid automatic retry, Round3 testing, portfolio/trade/signer access, new runtime or scheduler
